reasons.text: {\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}In a season of dreams,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N在这个梦幻般的赛季
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska comes through, emerging battle-hardened{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N赫瓦林斯卡历经苦战
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}to defeat Maria Sakkari{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N击败萨卡里
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}to reach her third career WTA semifinal.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N生涯第三次跻身巡回赛四强
{\an2}{\fs78}6{\fs68}比{\fs78}0{\fs68} 只是这场比赛的开头
{\an2}月亮姐遇到萨卡里 昨天
{\an2}她刚刚第一次打进{\fs78}1000{\fs68}赛八强
{\an2}首盘{\fs78}4{\fs68}比{\fs78}0{\fs68}接发 这个回合里
{\an2}月亮姐沿底线横向移动
{\an2}把打向两侧的球一次次救回
{\an2}兑现破发点
{\an2}自己一次破发点都没给
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska, statistically,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N从数据来看 赫瓦林斯卡
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}one of the best returners on tour in 2026.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N是今年巡回赛最强接发者之一
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Oh, and the opening set is a runaway train in 30 minutes.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N首盘势如破竹 只用了{\fs78}30{\fs68}分钟
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska leaves Maria Sakkari on the platform all alone.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N萨卡里像被独自留在站台
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}A blistering start for the Pole.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N波兰姑娘的开局太强势了
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Six-love.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N{\fs78}6{\fs68}比{\fs78}0{\fs68}！
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}In the first quarterfinal at a WTA 1000.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N首次{\fs78}1000{\fs68}赛{\fs78}1{\fs68}/{\fs78}4{\fs68}决赛
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska in the driver's seat.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N赫瓦林斯卡牢牢掌控局面
{\an2}第二盘 萨卡里没有放手
{\an2}{\fs78}0{\fs68}比{\fs78}1{\fs68} 月亮姐发球面对破发点
{\an2}萨卡里从底线把球连续打向两侧
{\an2}再跟进到场内 拿下这局
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Break secured.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N终于破发了
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}And a big bellow from Sakkari,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N萨卡里发出一声怒吼
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}as she knows she's back in it.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N她知道自己重回竞争了
{\an2}萨卡里先赢{\fs78}3{\fs68}局
{\an2}月亮姐随后稳住发球局
{\an2}却一直没能破回去
{\an2}{\fs78}3{\fs68}比{\fs78}6{\fs68} 比赛来到决胜盘
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}And Maria Sakkari completes her mission.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N萨卡里完成了这一盘的任务
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Get the second set in pocket,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N拿下第二盘
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}take it all the way to a third set,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N把比赛拖进决胜盘
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}and try your hand to be a semifinalist once again.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N再争一次四强席位
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska will have to regroup,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N赫瓦林斯卡需要重新调整
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}as it's Sakkari who takes set number two,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N萨卡里拿下了第二盘
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}six-three, in just under an hour.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N{\fs78}6{\fs68}比{\fs78}3{\fs68} 用时不到一小时
{\an2}决胜盘 {\fs78}2{\fs68}比{\fs78}2{\fs68} 她先救下破发点
{\an2}前{\fs78}11{\fs68}局 双方都保住发球局
{\an2}{\fs78}6{\fs68}比{\fs78}5{\fs68} 月亮姐又站到接发位置
{\an2}她先救下对手一个局点
{\an2}再拿到全场第一个赛点
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}In a season of dreams,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N在这个梦幻般的赛季
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja Chwalinska comes through, emerging battle-hardened{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N赫瓦林斯卡历经苦战
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}to defeat Maria Sakkari{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N击败萨卡里
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}to reach her third career WTA semifinal.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N生涯第三次跻身巡回赛四强
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}What an effort by the Pole.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N波兰姑娘付出了多大的努力！
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}A dominant opening set, score-wise;{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N首盘比分看上去一边倒
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}she had to outlast the Greek in the end.{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N最终靠苦战才熬过希腊对手
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}And when it seemed the experience of Sakkari{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N当萨卡里的经验似乎
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}might prevail in the end,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N就要决定最终胜负
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}Maja says, “No, no, not this year,{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N玛雅用表现说 今年不行
{\an2}{\fnInter 24pt SemiBold\b0\fs44\bord2.5\fsp0.6}not this tournament.”{\fnNoto Sans CJK SC\b1\fs68\bord4\fsp0}\N这项赛事也不行
{\an2}月亮姐{\fs78}25{\fs68}个制胜分 萨卡里{\fs78}37{\fs68}个
{\an2}决胜盘{\fs78}6{\fs68}个发球局全部保住
{\an2}她把突破留在了最后一局
{\an2}这一场苦战过后
{\an2}月亮姐第一次晋级{\fs78}1000{\fs68}赛半决赛
{\an2}下一关是斯瓦泰克和李安之间的胜者
{\an2}这趟武汉之旅 她还能走多远？
